description: This file contains functions for generating C++ code related to JSON-RPC, including emitting event handlers, registering and unregistering methods, and managing versioning. It appears to be part of a code generator or emitter for RPC interfaces.

methods.name: EmitEvent
methods.description: Generates C++ code for emitting a JSON-RPC event handler based on provided event data and parameters.

methods.name: _EmitRpcPrologue
methods.description: Generates the prologue part of the RPC code, including includes, namespace declarations, and version info.

methods.name: _EmitRpcEpilogue
methods.description: Generates the epilogue part of the RPC code, closing namespaces.

methods.name: _EmitVersionCode
methods.description: Emits versioning namespace with major, minor, and patch version constants.

methods.name: EmitRpcCode
methods.description: Generates the full RPC code including registration, deregistration, and event handling functions.

methods.name: EmitRpcVersionCode
methods.description: Generates version code for the RPC interface.
